notes.title: OmniCatGirl DLC Released!
notes.content:
Free DLC with a new character and a new weapon coming into OmniFootman! 

-New character can be selected when restarting a new game.
-New weapon is available and by default unlocked to all game progress.

notes.title: Update 2020/4/11
notes.content:
Updated:
1.Character fall ending animation will only trigger if falling process last longer than 1 second.
2.Added a particle effect when activating power sets.
3.Optimized some gamepad control setting so game and UI have better input consistency.
4.Added cartoon outline effect, can be turned on/off in graphic settings.
5.Update Unreal Engine version to 4.24 to fix crash cases for certain graphic card.

notes.title: Mini Update
notes.content:
-Fixed more sound channel mistakes. Hopefully there's no more.
-Now executable enemy will be auto-locked if player has no locked target.

notes.title: Russian version added
notes.content: Provided by Pavel, the game has Russian localization now.

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.content:
-Fixed a bug that cause player being able to go outside the map in lower city.
-Now you cannot trigger free reforge if you do not have enough gold to reforge the selected item.
-Fixed some sound channel mistakes.
-Fixed several bugs that cause the game to crash.
-Tried to fix a bug that cause achievement to fail, need further investigation.
